faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Nagpur Project Technical Support III recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the AIIMS Nagpur Project Technical Support III posts is 20th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Technical Support III post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Project Technical Support III position at AIIMS Nagpur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a three-year graduate degree in relevant fields like Medical Social Work, Medical Psychology, or Medical Physiotherapy, along with three years of experience, or a PG degree in a related field.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Technical Support III role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 35 years, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support III position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 28,000 plus HRA (20% of basic).

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for AIIMS Nagpur Project Technical Support III recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test/Skill Test, followed by an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official AIIMS Nagpur website.

faq.question: Q9. Where is AIIMS Nagpur located?
faq.answer: AIIMS Nagpur is located in Nagpur, Maharashtra, with the pincode 441124.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The position of Project Technical Support III is on a contract basis.
